brief.visitor: A South Florida property professional deciding whether Esteban can make their listings look worth viewing.
brief.purpose: Replace the low-quality real-estate route still with a credible moving Brickell property scene.
brief.desiredFeeling: Cinematic, clear, and specific—not a generic dark service poster.
brief.scope: Only the closed Real estate route card. Preserve the Content creator and subsequent cards unchanged.
acceptance: Use the approved Pexels Brickell phone loop with a still poster fallback.
The route title and its one-sentence explanation stay unobstructed at 375x600 and 390x844.
The motion stops for reduced-motion users and does not gate text or the open control.
The fixed phone navigation cannot cover the card's text or control.

learning.outcome: A clearer real-estate route selection on the homepage.
learning.baseline: UNKNOWN; no route-selection denominator has been inspected in this task.
learning.hypothesis: A high-quality, relevant moving Brickell scene will make the real-estate route as legible and credible as the approved Content creator route.
learning.decisionWindow: Visual verification before release; route-selection measurement after production deployment.
